meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are survey estimates from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. OEWS counts employees only and is rounded by the bureau; the monthly series are seasonally adjusted and revised; the state rates cover all nonfarm employers in a state, not only law firms. Pay is a statistic for a group of workers, not an offer or a guide to what one firm should pay.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.
